cards.prompt_en: A part of the company: "a department"
cards.explanation_en: *Ekonomiavdelningen* = the finance department. Also a hospital ward.

cards.swedish_prompt: Ce qu’on soumet en réunion : « une proposition »
cards.explanation_md: *Lägga fram ett förslag* = présenter une proposition. Verbe : *föreslå*.
cards.prompt_en: What you put forward in a meeting: "a proposal"
cards.explanation_en: *Lägga fram ett förslag* = put forward a proposal. Verb: *föreslå*.

cards.swedish_prompt: Une part d’une entreprise en bourse : « une action »
cards.explanation_md: Pluriel : *aktier*. La bourse : *börsen*. Un fonds : *en fond*.
cards.prompt_en: A share of a listed company: "a share"
cards.explanation_en: Plural: *aktier*. The stock exchange: *börsen*. A fund: *en fond*.

cards.swedish_prompt: Le crédit pour acheter un logement : « un prêt immobilier »
cards.explanation_md: *bo* (habiter) + *lån* (prêt). Sensible à *räntan* (le taux).
cards.prompt_en: The loan for buying a home: "a mortgage"
cards.explanation_en: *bo* (live) + *lån* (loan). Sensitive to *räntan* (the interest rate).

cards.swedish_prompt: Ce que quelque chose coûte : « un coût »
cards.explanation_md: Souvent au pluriel : *kostnaderna ökar* (les coûts augmentent).
cards.explanation_en: Often plural: *kostnaderna ökar* (costs are rising).

cards.explanation_md: *in* (dedans) + *komst* (venue). L’impôt sur le revenu : *inkomstskatt*.
cards.explanation_en: *in* + *komst* (coming). Income tax: *inkomstskatt*.

cards.swedish_prompt: Quand l’économie va très mal : « une crise »
cards.explanation_md: Pluriel : *kriser*. *Finanskrisen* = la crise financière.
cards.prompt_en: When the economy is in trouble: "a crisis"
cards.explanation_en: Plural: *kriser*. *Finanskrisen* = the financial crisis.

cards.swedish_prompt: Une période où l’économie ralentit : « une récession »
cards.explanation_md: *låg* (bas) + *konjunktur* (conjoncture). Le contraire : *högkonjunktur*.
cards.explanation_en: *låg* (low) + *konjunktur* (economic cycle). The opposite: *högkonjunktur*.

cards.swedish_prompt: Pour les soins graves et les urgences : « l’hôpital »
cards.explanation_md: *sjuk* (malade) + *hus* (maison). Les urgences : *akuten*.
cards.prompt_en: For serious care and emergencies: "the hospital"
cards.explanation_en: *sjuk* (sick) + *hus* (house). The emergency room: *akuten*.

cards.explanation_md: Le **ti** se prononce [sɪ]. Accent sur la fin.
cards.explanation_en: The **ti** sounds like [sɪ]. Stress at the end.

cards.swedish_prompt: L’argent touché après la vie active : « une retraite »
cards.explanation_md: Le **sion** se prononce [ɧuːn]. Partir à la retraite : *gå i pension*.
cards.prompt_en: Money after your working life: "a pension"
cards.explanation_en: The **sion** is [ɧuːn]. To retire: *gå i pension*.

cards.explanation_md: *barn* (enfant) + *bidrag* (contribution). Versé par *Försäkringskassan* jusqu’à 16 ans.
cards.prompt_en: The benefit paid for every child: "child benefit"
cards.explanation_en: *barn* (child) + *bidrag* (allowance). Paid by *Försäkringskassan* until 16.

cards.explanation_md: *arbetslöshetskassa*, abrégé. L’adhésion est volontaire, souvent via le syndicat.
cards.explanation_en: Short for *arbetslöshetskassa*. Membership is voluntary, often through a union.

cards.swedish_prompt: Le médecin des dents : « un dentiste »
cards.explanation_md: *tand* (dent) + *läkare* (médecin). Gratuit jusqu’à 23 ans, ensuite payant.
cards.explanation_en: *tand* (tooth) + *läkare* (doctor). Free up to age 23, then paid.

cards.explanation_md: Infinitif *öka*, 1er groupe. *Temperaturen ökar.* Le nom : *en ökning*.
cards.explanation_en: Infinitive *öka*, group 1. *Temperaturen ökar.* Noun: *en ökning*.

cards.swedish_prompt: Ce qu’on récupère en rendant une canette : « une consigne »
cards.explanation_md: *Panta burkar* = rapporter les canettes au supermarché, 1 à 2 kronor pièce.
cards.prompt_en: What you get back for returning a can: "a deposit"
cards.explanation_en: *Panta burkar* = return cans at the supermarket, 1 to 2 kronor each.

cards.swedish_prompt: Le principal gaz à effet de serre
cards.explanation_md: *kol* (carbone) + *dioxid*. Souvent : *koldioxidutsläpp* (émissions de CO2).
cards.explanation_en: *kol* (carbon) + *dioxid*. Often: *koldioxidutsläpp* (CO2 emissions).

cards.swedish_prompt: L’électricité produite par le vent : « l’éolien »
cards.explanation_md: *vind* (vent) + *kraft* (force). Une éolienne : *ett vindkraftverk*.
cards.explanation_en: *vind* (wind) + *kraft* (power). A wind turbine: *ett vindkraftverk*.

cards.swedish_prompt: Bus, métro, train : « les transports en commun »
cards.explanation_md: À l’oral : *åka kollektivt* = prendre les transports en commun.
cards.explanation_en: In speech: *åka kollektivt* = take public transport.

cards.swedish_prompt: Quand l’eau envahit tout : « une inondation »
cards.explanation_md: *över* (par-dessus) + *svämma* (déborder). De plus en plus fréquentes avec le climat.
cards.explanation_en: *över* (over) + *svämma* (overflow). Increasingly frequent with climate change.

cards.swedish_prompt: Réussir sans effort, grâce à d’autres
cards.english_translation: have it handed to you on a plate
cards.explanation_md: Littéralement « glisser sur un sandwich aux crevettes ». Se dit de quelqu’un de privilégié.
cards.french_translation: avoir tout servi sur un plateau
cards.explanation_en: Literally "slide in on a shrimp sandwich". Said of someone privileged.

cards.swedish_prompt: Se douter que quelque chose cloche
cards.explanation_md: Littéralement « soupçonner des hiboux dans le marais ». *Jag anar ugglor i mossen.*
cards.explanation_en: Literally "suspect owls in the bog". *Jag anar ugglor i mossen.*

cards.explanation_md: Littéralement « mettre de l’oignon sur le saumon ». Ironique : on gâche ce qui était déjà là.
cards.explanation_en: Literally "put onion on the salmon". Ironic: spoiling what was already there.

cards.swedish_prompt: Quelque chose d’évident : « clair comme de l’eau de roche »
cards.explanation_md: Littéralement « clair comme l’eau de cuisson des saucisses ». Souvent ironique : *Det är väl klart som korvspad!*
cards.french_translation: clair comme de l’eau de roche
cards.explanation_en: Literally "clear as sausage water". Often ironic: *Det är väl klart som korvspad!*

cards.swedish_prompt: Refuser catégoriquement : « pour rien au monde »
cards.swedish_target: inte för allt smör i Småland
cards.english_translation: not for all the tea in China
cards.explanation_md: Littéralement « pas pour tout le beurre du Småland », une région agricole.
cards.prompt_en: Refusing flatly: "not for all the tea in China"
cards.explanation_en: Literally "not for all the butter in Småland", a farming region.

cards.swedish_prompt: Juger tout le monde pareil : « mettre tout le monde dans le même sac »
cards.english_translation: tar everyone with the same brush
cards.explanation_md: Littéralement « passer tout le monde au même peigne ». *Man ska inte dra alla över en kam.*
cards.french_translation: mettre tout le monde dans le même sac
cards.prompt_en: Judging everyone alike: "tar everyone with the same brush"
cards.explanation_en: Literally "pull everyone through one comb". *Man ska inte dra alla över en kam.*

cards.swedish_prompt: Pour donner une cause : « puisque / parce que »
cards.explanation_md: Conjonction de subordination : *Eftersom det regnade, stannade vi hemma.* En tête, elle entraîne V2 dans la principale.
cards.explanation_en: A subordinating conjunction: *Eftersom det regnade, stannade vi hemma.* Fronted, it triggers V2 in the main clause.

cards.swedish_prompt: Annoncer son avis, en registre soutenu
cards.explanation_md: Plus soutenu que *jag tycker*. En tête de phrase, le verbe suit (V2).
cards.explanation_en: More formal than *jag tycker*. At the start of a sentence, the verb follows (V2).

cards.swedish_prompt: Pour annoncer le premier argument : « premièrement »
cards.explanation_md: Puis *för det andra* (deuxièmement). Comme tout adverbial en tête, il entraîne V2.
cards.explanation_en: Then *för det andra* (secondly). Like any fronted adverbial, it triggers V2.

cards.swedish_prompt: Pour conclure un exposé : « en résumé »
cards.explanation_md: *sammanfattning* (résumé) + *-vis* (de manière). Même modèle : *förhoppningsvis* (avec un peu de chance).
cards.prompt_en: Wrapping up a talk: "to sum up"
cards.explanation_en: *sammanfattning* (summary) + *-vis* (-ly). Same pattern: *förhoppningsvis* (hopefully).

cards.explanation_md: *Det var dyrt, men vi köpte det ändå.* Se place après le verbe ou en fin de phrase.
cards.explanation_en: *Det var dyrt, men vi köpte det ändå.* Goes after the verb or at the end.

cards.swedish_prompt: Une raison qui soutient une thèse : « un argument »
cards.explanation_md: Mot **ett**, invariable au pluriel. Une dispute se dit *ett gräl*, pas *argument*.
cards.prompt_en: A reason supporting a view: "an argument"
cards.explanation_en: **ett** word, unchanged in the plural. A quarrel is *ett gräl*, not *argument*.

cards.explanation_md: Au sens propre « cruel », mais chez les jeunes : *Det var grymt!* = c’était génial !
cards.explanation_en: Literally "cruel", but among young people: *Det var grymt!* = that was awesome!

cards.swedish_prompt: Le petit mot qui ponctue l’oral : « genre / enfin »
cards.explanation_md: Forme orale de *alltså*. *Asså, jag vet inte.* À éviter à l’écrit soutenu.
cards.prompt_en: The filler word in speech: "like / I mean"
cards.explanation_en: Spoken form of *alltså*. *Asså, jag vet inte.* Avoid in formal writing.

cards.explanation_md: *Ska vi käka?* = on mange ? Registre neutre : *äta*.
cards.explanation_en: *Ska vi käka?* = shall we eat? Neutral: *äta*.

cards.swedish_prompt: Ce qui est pénible ou fatigant
cards.explanation_md: Très courant à l’oral : *Vad jobbigt!* = quelle galère !
cards.explanation_en: Very common in speech: *Vad jobbigt!* = what a pain!

cards.explanation_md: Devant un adjectif : *sjukt bra* = trop bien. Sens propre : malade (*sjuk*).
cards.explanation_en: Before an adjective: *sjukt bra* = insanely good. Literally: sick (*sjuk*).

cards.swedish_prompt: Pour introduire un motif, en style administratif
cards.explanation_md: Début typique de courriel officiel : *Med anledning av ditt mejl…*
cards.prompt_en: Introducing a reason, in official style
cards.explanation_en: Typical start of an official email: *Med anledning av ditt mejl…*

cards.swedish_prompt: Se quitter en promettant de se reparler : « on s’appelle »
cards.explanation_md: Forme réciproque en **-s** de *höra* (entendre). Pendant de *vi ses*.
cards.french_translation: on s’appelle / on se tient au courant
cards.prompt_en: Saying goodbye, promising to talk: "talk soon"
cards.explanation_en: Reciprocal **-s** form of *höra* (hear). The phone version of *vi ses*.

cards.explanation_md: Défini de *en drottning*. Le château royal : *Drottningholm*, « l’île de la reine ».
cards.explanation_en: Definite of *en drottning*. The royal palace: *Drottningholm*, "the queen’s island".

cards.swedish_prompt: Le contraire de la paix : « une guerre »
cards.explanation_md: Mot **ett**. La paix : *fred*. La Suède n’a pas connu de guerre depuis 1814.
cards.explanation_en: **ett** word. Peace: *fred*. Sweden has not been at war since 1814.

cards.swedish_prompt: Celui qui fuit la guerre : « un réfugié »
cards.explanation_md: De *fly* (fuir). Pluriel : *flyktingar*.
cards.explanation_en: From *fly* (flee). Plural: *flyktingar*.

cards.swedish_prompt: Le droit de participer aux élections : « le droit de vote »
cards.explanation_md: *röst* (voix) + *rätt* (droit). Suffrage universel en Suède : 1921.
cards.prompt_en: The right to take part in elections: "suffrage"
cards.explanation_en: *röst* (vote) + *rätt* (right). Universal suffrage in Sweden: 1921.

cards.explanation_md: Le **tion** se prononce [ɧuːn]. Adjectif : *traditionell*.
cards.explanation_en: The **tion** is [ɧuːn]. Adjective: *traditionell*.

cards.explanation_md: *år* (an) + *hundra* (cent). Plus courant pour les dates : *1900-talet* (le XXe siècle).
cards.explanation_en: *år* (year) + *hundra* (hundred). More common for dates: *1900-talet* (the 20th century).

cards.explanation_md: **beaucoup** = mycket. **eau** uttalas [o], och slutets **p** är stumt.
cards.explanation_en: **beaucoup** = a lot. **eau** is pronounced [o], and the final **p** is silent.

cards.explanation_md: Ordagrant ”av ingenting”. Artigare: **je vous en prie**.
cards.explanation_en: Literally "of nothing". More polite: **je vous en prie**.

cards.swedish_prompt: Innan man går och lägger sig
cards.explanation_md: Bara när någon ska sova. Mot kvällen säger man *bonsoir*.
cards.explanation_en: Only when someone is going to sleep. In the evening you say *bonsoir*.

cards.explanation_md: Samma mönster som *à bientôt*: **à** + tidpunkt. *À lundi!* = vi ses på måndag!
cards.explanation_en: Same pattern as *à bientôt*: **à** + a time. *À lundi !* = see you Monday!

cards.swedish_prompt: Kort ursäkt, till exempel när du stöter till någon
cards.explanation_md: Med frågeton betyder **Pardon ?** ”Förlåt, vad sa du?”
cards.prompt_en: Short apology, for example when you bump into someone
cards.explanation_en: With a rising tone, **Pardon ?** means "Sorry, what did you say?"

cards.explanation_md: Som svar på ett tack i Québec betyder det ”ingen orsak”. I Frankrike: *de rien*.
cards.explanation_en: In Quebec it also answers a thank you ("you’re welcome"). In France: *de rien*.

cards.explanation_md: Det är vad du får om du bara beställer *un café*. Bindning: *un‿expresso*.
cards.explanation_en: This is what you get if you just order *un café*. Liaison: *un‿expresso*.

cards.explanation_md: Fatöl: **une pression**. En liten: **un demi** (25 cl).
cards.explanation_en: Draught beer: **une pression**. A small one: **un demi** (25 cl).

cards.swedish_prompt: Den varma smörgåsen med skinka och ost
cards.english_translation: a toasted ham and cheese sandwich
cards.explanation_md: Klassiker på kaféer. Med ett stekt ägg på: **un croque-madame**.
cards.french_translation: en varm macka med skinka och ost
cards.prompt_en: The hot ham and cheese sandwich
cards.explanation_en: A café classic. With a fried egg on top: **un croque-madame**.

cards.explanation_md: En sockerbit: **un sucre**. *Avec du sucre ?* = med socker?
cards.explanation_en: A sugar lump: **un sucre**. *Avec du sucre ?* = with sugar?

cards.explanation_md: *Un café sans sucre* = kaffe utan socker. **sans** är ett nasalljud: n:et hörs inte.
cards.explanation_en: *Un café sans sucre* = coffee without sugar. **sans** is nasal: the n is not heard.

cards.explanation_md: Kallas också **une tisane**. Vanligt efter middagen: *une verveine* (citronverbena).
cards.explanation_en: Also called **une tisane**. Common after dinner: *une verveine* (lemon verbena).

cards.explanation_md: Franskan skiljer inte på far- och morbror: båda är **l’oncle**.
cards.explanation_en: French makes no difference between sides of the family: both are **l’oncle**.

cards.explanation_md: Samma ord för faster och moster. Slutets **e** är stumt men gör att **t** hörs.
cards.explanation_en: Same word on both sides. The final **e** is silent but makes the **t** heard.

cards.swedish_prompt: Barnet till din farbror eller moster
cards.explanation_md: Hankön *cousin* slutar på ett nasalljud; honkön *cousine* uttalar **n**.
cards.prompt_en: The child of your uncle or aunt
cards.explanation_en: Masculine *cousin* ends in a nasal vowel; feminine *cousine* pronounces the **n**.

cards.explanation_md: Svenskan säger varifrån: *brorson, systerdotter*. Franskan har bara två ord.
cards.explanation_en: Swedish says which side: *brorson, systerdotter*. French has just two words.

cards.swedish_prompt: Att ha en make eller maka
cards.explanation_md: Kvinnan skriver *mariée*, men uttalet är detsamma. *Je suis marié.*
cards.explanation_en: A woman writes *mariée*, but it sounds the same. *Je suis marié.*

cards.explanation_md: Bindning: *petits‿enfants*, s:et uttalas [z]. En: *le petit-fils, la petite-fille*.
cards.explanation_en: Liaison: *petits‿enfants*, the s sounds like [z]. Singular: *le petit-fils, la petite-fille*.

cards.explanation_md: Salt eller osaltat: **demi-sel** eller **doux**. Bretagne äter saltat.
cards.explanation_en: Salted or unsalted: **demi-sel** or **doux**. Brittany eats it salted.

cards.swedish_prompt: Det vita man häller i kaffet
cards.explanation_md: Slutets **t** är stumt: [lɛ]. *Un café au lait* = kaffe med mjölk.
cards.prompt_en: The white drink you pour in coffee
cards.explanation_en: The final **t** is silent: [lɛ]. *Un café au lait* = coffee with milk.

cards.explanation_md: Singular *un œuf* [œf], men plural *des œufs* [ø]: **f** försvinner.
cards.explanation_en: Singular *un œuf* [œf], but plural *des œufs* [ø]: the **f** disappears.

cards.explanation_md: Mindre i stan: *la supérette*. Mycket stor: *l’hypermarché*.
cards.explanation_en: Smaller in town: *la supérette*. Very large: *l’hypermarché*.

cards.explanation_md: Plastpåsar är förbjudna i kassan: ta med **un sac** själv.
cards.explanation_en: Plastic bags are banned at the checkout: bring your own **sac**.

cards.explanation_md: Kassören: **le caissier / la caissière**. Självbetjäning: *les caisses automatiques*.
cards.explanation_en: The cashier: **le caissier / la caissière**. Self-checkout: *les caisses automatiques*.

cards.explanation_md: Franskan säger oftast *pas cher* (inte dyrt) i stället för *bon marché*.
cards.explanation_en: French usually says *pas cher* (not expensive) rather than *bon marché*.

cards.explanation_md: Slutets **t** är stumt. Klassiker: *le poulet rôti* (grillad kyckling).
cards.explanation_en: The final **t** is silent. A classic: *le poulet rôti* (roast chicken).

cards.explanation_md: Dubbelt **ss** = [s]. Akta: *le poison* med ett s [z] betyder gift!
cards.prompt_en: From the sea or the lake
cards.explanation_en: Double **ss** = [s]. Careful: *le poison* with one s [z] means poison!

cards.explanation_md: Nötkött: *le bœuf*. Fläsk: *le porc*. Lamm: *l’agneau*.
cards.explanation_en: Beef: *le bœuf*. Pork: *le porc*. Lamb: *l’agneau*.

cards.explanation_md: Klassiker: *un steak-frites*. Belgierna menar att de uppfann dem.
cards.explanation_en: A classic: *un steak-frites*. The Belgians claim to have invented them.

cards.explanation_md: *Je suis végétarienne* (kvinna). Honkönet uttalar **n**.
cards.explanation_en: *Je suis végétarienne* (woman). The feminine pronounces the **n**.

cards.explanation_md: Kranvatten är gratis: *une carafe d’eau*. Flaskvatten kostar.
cards.explanation_en: Tap water is free: *une carafe d’eau*. Bottled water costs money.

cards.explanation_md: Kort för *le tramway*. Finns i de flesta storstäder, till exempel Bordeaux och Strasbourg.
cards.explanation_en: Short for *le tramway*. Found in most big cities, such as Bordeaux and Strasbourg.

cards.explanation_md: **qu** = [k]. *Le train part du quai B.* Spåret: *la voie*.
cards.prompt_en: Where you wait for the train
cards.explanation_en: **qu** = [k]. *Le train part du quai B.* The track: *la voie*.

cards.swedish_prompt: När tåget inte kommer i tid
cards.explanation_md: *Être en retard* = vara sen. *Le train a dix minutes de retard.*
cards.prompt_en: When the train is not on time
cards.explanation_en: *Être en retard* = to be late. *Le train a dix minutes de retard.*

cards.explanation_md: Från *arrêter* (stanna). *Le prochain arrêt* = nästa hållplats.
cards.explanation_en: From *arrêter* (to stop). *Le prochain arrêt* = the next stop.

cards.explanation_md: I metron: följ skylten *Correspondance* för att byta linje.
cards.explanation_en: In the metro: follow the *Correspondance* sign to change lines.

cards.explanation_md: Samma ord som på svenska. Appar som *Uber* heter *un VTC* i Frankrike.
cards.explanation_en: Same word as in English. Ride-hailing cars are called *un VTC* in France.

cards.explanation_md: Adjektiv: *nuageux* (molnigt). *Il y a des nuages.*
cards.explanation_en: Adjective: *nuageux* (cloudy). *Il y a des nuages.*

cards.explanation_md: Ordagrant ”det finns vind”. Man kan också säga *il fait du vent*.
cards.explanation_en: Literally "there is some wind". You can also say *il fait du vent*.

cards.explanation_md: Maskulinum: *un orage*. Vanligt i augusti i södra Frankrike.
cards.explanation_en: Masculine: *un orage*. Common in August in southern France.

cards.swedish_prompt: Det som faller när det regnar
cards.explanation_md: Verbet: *il pleut*. **ui** uttalas [ɥi], som ett snabbt y + i.
cards.explanation_en: The verb: *il pleut*. **ui** is [ɥi], a quick rounded glide + i.

cards.explanation_md: Verbet: *il neige*. **ei** uttalas [ɛ].
cards.explanation_en: The verb: *il neige*. **ei** is pronounced [ɛ].

cards.explanation_md: *para* (mot) + *pluie* (regn). Svenskans *paraply* kommer härifrån.
cards.explanation_en: *para* (against) + *pluie* (rain). Swedish *paraply* comes from it.

cards.swedish_prompt: Den man öppnar för att gå in
cards.explanation_md: *Fermer la porte à clé* = låsa dörren. Ytterdörren: *la porte d’entrée*.
cards.prompt_en: What you open to go in
cards.explanation_en: *Fermer la porte à clé* = lock the door. Front door: *la porte d’entrée*.

cards.explanation_md: Cirkumflexen **ê** visar att ett s har fallit bort (jämför engelska *fenestration*).
cards.explanation_en: The circumflex **ê** marks a lost s.

cards.explanation_md: Maskulinum: *un ascenseur*. Många gamla hus i Paris saknar hiss.
cards.explanation_en: Masculine: *un ascenseur*. Many old Paris buildings have no lift.

cards.explanation_md: Slutet är ett nasalljud: n:et uttalas inte.
cards.explanation_en: It ends in a nasal vowel: the n is not pronounced.

cards.explanation_md: Slutets **t** är stumt: [li]. Bädda sängen: *faire son lit*.
cards.explanation_en: The final **t** is silent: [li]. Make your bed: *faire son lit*.

cards.explanation_md: Maskulinum. *Monter l’escalier* = gå uppför trappan.
cards.explanation_en: Masculine. *Monter l’escalier* = go up the stairs.

cards.swedish_prompt: Det man gör i badrummet morgon och kväll
cards.explanation_md: Reflexivt verb: *je me brosse les dents*. Ingen possessiv: *les dents*, inte *mes dents*.
cards.prompt_en: What you do in the bathroom morning and night
cards.explanation_en: Reflexive verb: *je me brosse les dents*. No possessive: *les dents*, not *mes dents*.

cards.explanation_md: *Je me lève tôt.* Slutkonsonanterna **t** och **d** är stumma.
cards.explanation_en: *Je me lève tôt.* The final **t** and **d** are silent.

cards.explanation_md: *Il est huit heures et quart* = kvart över åtta. *Neuf heures moins le quart* = kvart i nio.
cards.explanation_en: *Il est huit heures et quart* = quarter past eight. *Neuf heures moins le quart* = quarter to nine.

cards.explanation_md: Från *goûter* (smaka). Ofta en bit bröd med choklad efter skolan.
cards.explanation_en: From *goûter* (to taste). Often bread with chocolate after school.

cards.explanation_md: Oregelbundet: *je dors, tu dors, il dort*. *Bien dormi ?* = sov du gott?
cards.explanation_en: Irregular: *je dors, tu dors, il dort*. *Bien dormi ?* = did you sleep well?

cards.explanation_md: *Faire la sieste* = ta en tupplur. Vanligt i södra Frankrike på sommaren.
cards.explanation_en: *Faire la sieste* = take a nap. Common in southern France in summer.

cards.swedish_prompt: När kollegorna samlas för att diskutera
cards.explanation_md: *Je suis en réunion* = jag sitter i möte. Akta: inte en ”återförening”.
cards.explanation_en: *Je suis en réunion* = I’m in a meeting.

cards.explanation_md: Maskulinum. Bärbar dator: *un ordinateur portable*, ofta bara *un portable*.
cards.prompt_en: The work tool with a screen
cards.explanation_en: Masculine. Laptop: *un ordinateur portable*, often just *un portable*.

cards.explanation_md: Ledigt: *le / la prof*. I grundskolan: *l’instituteur / l’institutrice* eller *le maître*.
cards.explanation_en: Casual: *le / la prof*. In primary school: *l’instituteur / l’institutrice*.

cards.explanation_md: Honkönsformen *ingénieure* uttalas likadant.
cards.prompt_en: The person who designs and calculates
cards.explanation_en: The feminine *ingénieure* sounds the same.

cards.explanation_md: Hankön slutar på nasalljud; honkön uttalar **t**.
cards.prompt_en: The person buying from the company
cards.explanation_en: The masculine ends in a nasal vowel; the feminine pronounces the **t**.

cards.explanation_md: **ill** uttalas [j]: *je travaille* [tʁavaj]. Ledigt: *bosser*.
cards.explanation_en: **ill** is pronounced [j]: *je travaille* [tʁavaj]. Slang: *bosser*.

cards.explanation_md: Oregelbundet: *je lis, nous lisons*, perfekt *j’ai lu*.
cards.explanation_en: Irregular: *je lis, nous lisons*, perfect *j’ai lu*.

cards.explanation_md: **th** uttalas [t]. *Aller au théâtre* = gå på teater.
cards.explanation_en: **th** sounds like [t]. *Aller au théâtre* = go to the theatre.

cards.explanation_md: *Nous nageons*: ett **e** behålls framför **o** för att **g** ska låta [ʒ].
cards.prompt_en: In the pool or the sea
cards.explanation_en: *Nous nageons*: an **e** stays before **o** to keep the **g** soft [ʒ].

cards.explanation_md: **qu** = [k]. *Écouter de la musique* = lyssna på musik.
cards.explanation_en: **qu** = [k]. *Écouter de la musique* = listen to music.

cards.explanation_md: Plural: *les jeux vidéo* (*vidéo* böjs inte). *Jouer aux jeux vidéo.*
cards.explanation_en: Plural: *les jeux vidéo* (*vidéo* does not change). *Jouer aux jeux vidéo.*

cards.explanation_md: Regelbundet verb på *-er*. *On va danser ce soir ?*
cards.explanation_en: Regular *-er* verb. *On va danser ce soir ?*

cards.explanation_md: Slutets **s** är stumt. *Je me suis cassé le bras* = jag bröt armen.
cards.explanation_en: The final **s** is silent. *Je me suis cassé le bras* = I broke my arm.

cards.explanation_md: *J’ai mal à la jambe.* **am** framför konsonant är ett nasalljud.
cards.explanation_en: *J’ai mal à la jambe.* **am** before a consonant is nasal.

cards.explanation_md: Tandläkaren: *le / la dentiste*. *J’ai mal aux dents* (*à + les = aux*).
cards.explanation_en: The dentist: *le / la dentiste*. *J’ai mal aux dents* (*à + les = aux*).

cards.swedish_prompt: Det halsen gör när den är irriterad
cards.explanation_md: Hostan: *la toux*. Dubbelt **ss** = [s]; jämför *tout* med ett s.
cards.prompt_en: What your throat does when irritated
cards.explanation_en: The cough: *la toux*. Double **ss** = [s].

cards.explanation_md: Från *le rhume* (förkylningen). **rh** uttalas bara [ʁ].
cards.explanation_en: From *le rhume* (a cold). **rh** is just [ʁ].

cards.explanation_md: Alltid plural. Ring **15** (SAMU) för ambulans, **112** fungerar också.
cards.explanation_en: Always plural. Dial **15** (SAMU) for an ambulance; **112** works too.

cards.explanation_md: Damblus: *le chemisier*. Ensamt **s** mellan vokaler = [z].
cards.prompt_en: The garment with a collar and buttons
cards.explanation_en: A woman’s blouse: *le chemisier*. A single **s** between vowels = [z].

cards.explanation_md: Kort kjol: *une minijupe*. **u** uttalas som svenskt **y**.
cards.explanation_en: A short skirt: *une minijupe*. **u** is said with rounded lips.

cards.explanation_md: Plural med **x**: *les manteaux*. **eau** = [o].
cards.explanation_en: Plural with **x**: *les manteaux*. **eau** = [o].

cards.explanation_md: Singular på franska: *un jean*. Uttalas på engelska, [dʒin].
cards.explanation_en: Singular in French: *un jean*. Pronounced the English way, [dʒin].

cards.explanation_md: Slutets **t** är stumt. Hatt: *le chapeau*.
cards.explanation_en: The final **t** is silent. A hat: *le chapeau*.

cards.explanation_md: Samma form för båda könen: *un pull rouge, une robe rouge*.
cards.explanation_en: Same form for both genders: *un pull rouge, une robe rouge*.

cards.explanation_md: En tårta formad som en vedklabbe. *Noël* uttalas med två stavelser: [nɔ.ɛl].
cards.explanation_en: A cake shaped like a log. *Noël* has two syllables: [nɔ.ɛl].

cards.explanation_md: Hela namnet: *le sapin de Noël*. Slutar på nasalljud.
cards.prompt_en: The tree you decorate at Christmas
cards.explanation_en: Full name: *le sapin de Noël*. Ends in a nasal vowel.

cards.explanation_md: Plural: *les cadeaux*. *C’est pour offrir ?* = ska det slås in?
cards.explanation_en: Plural: *les cadeaux*. *C’est pour offrir ?* = is it a gift (shall I wrap it)?

cards.explanation_md: Bindning: *joyeux‿anniversaire*, x:et uttalas [z]. Kort: *bon anniversaire*.
cards.explanation_en: Liaison: *joyeux‿anniversaire*, the x sounds like [z]. Also: *bon anniversaire*.

cards.explanation_md: *nouvel* framför vokal i stället för *nouveau*. Nyårsafton: *la Saint-Sylvestre*.
cards.explanation_en: *nouvel* before a vowel instead of *nouveau*. New Year’s Eve: *la Saint-Sylvestre*.

cards.explanation_md: Med bovetemjöl och salt fyllning: *la galette*. Äts särskilt till *la Chandeleur*.
cards.explanation_en: Buckwheat with a savoury filling: *la galette*. Eaten especially at *la Chandeleur*.

cards.explanation_md: Inom EU räcker ofta id-kortet: *la carte d’identité*.
cards.explanation_en: Within the EU an ID card is often enough: *la carte d’identité*.

cards.explanation_md: Maskulinum. Paris har två stora: *Roissy-Charles-de-Gaulle* och *Orly*.
cards.explanation_en: Masculine. Paris has two big ones: *Roissy-Charles-de-Gaulle* and *Orly*.

cards.explanation_md: *Prendre l’avion* = flyga. *En avion* = med flyg.
cards.explanation_en: *Prendre l’avion* = to fly. *En avion* = by plane.

cards.explanation_md: **gn** uttalas [ɲ], som i *champagne*. Reflexivt: *on se baigne ?*
cards.prompt_en: Going in the sea or the lake
cards.explanation_en: **gn** is [ɲ], as in *champagne*. Reflexive: *on se baigne ?*

cards.explanation_md: *un étranger* = en utlänning. *Partir à l’étranger* = resa utomlands.
cards.explanation_en: *un étranger* = a foreigner. *Partir à l’étranger* = go abroad.

cards.explanation_md: Från *bronze* (brons). Solkräm: *la crème solaire*.
cards.explanation_en: From *bronze*. Sun cream: *la crème solaire*.

cards.swedish_prompt: Tillståndet att bo i Frankrike för en utomeuropé
cards.explanation_md: Söks på *la préfecture*. Svenskar som EU-medborgare behöver inget.
cards.prompt_en: The permit to live in France for a non-EU citizen
cards.explanation_en: Applied for at *la préfecture*. EU citizens such as Swedes do not need one.

cards.explanation_md: Verbet: *signer*. **gn** = [ɲ]. *Signez ici, s’il vous plaît.*
cards.prompt_en: Your handwritten name at the bottom
cards.explanation_en: The verb: *signer*. **gn** = [ɲ]. *Signez ici, s’il vous plaît.*

cards.explanation_md: Myndigheterna vill ofta ha både originalet och *une photocopie*.
cards.explanation_en: Offices often want both the original and *une photocopie*.

cards.swedish_prompt: Den tid man har på sig
cards.explanation_md: *Dans les délais* = i tid. *Quel est le délai ?* = hur lång tid tar det?
cards.explanation_en: *Dans les délais* = on time. *Quel est le délai ?* = how long does it take?

cards.swedish_prompt: Kortet som ger rätt att köra bil
cards.explanation_md: Ofta bara *le permis*. *Passer le permis* = ta körkort.
cards.prompt_en: The card that lets you drive
cards.explanation_en: Often just *le permis*. *Passer le permis* = take your driving test.

cards.explanation_md: *Votre passeport n’est plus valable* = ditt pass är inte längre giltigt.
cards.explanation_en: *Votre passeport n’est plus valable* = your passport is no longer valid.

cards.explanation_md: *Le voisin de palier* = grannen på samma våning.
cards.prompt_en: The landing outside the flat doors
cards.explanation_en: *Le voisin de palier* = the neighbour on the same floor.

cards.swedish_prompt: Där besökare ringer på nere vid porten
cards.explanation_md: *Sonne à l’interphone* = ring på porttelefonen.
cards.prompt_en: Where visitors ring at the street door
cards.explanation_en: *Sonne à l’interphone* = buzz the intercom.

cards.explanation_md: Mycket vanligt i Paris. *C’est quoi, le code ?*
cards.prompt_en: The code to open the street door
cards.explanation_en: Very common in Paris. *C’est quoi, le code ?*

cards.explanation_md: *aux* = *à + les*. Namnet skrivs på en liten skylt på lådan.
cards.explanation_en: *aux* = *à + les*. Your name goes on a small label on the box.

cards.explanation_md: Juridisk term: kan ge böter efter klockan 22.
cards.explanation_en: A legal term: it can lead to a fine after 10 pm.

cards.explanation_md: *Sortir les poubelles* = ta ut soporna. Gula tunnan: återvinning.
cards.explanation_en: *Sortir les poubelles* = take the bins out. The yellow bin is for recycling.

cards.explanation_md: Maskulinum = tjänst. Femininum *la poste* = posten (brev). Samma uttal.
cards.explanation_en: Masculine = a job. Feminine *la poste* = the post office. Same sound.

cards.swedish_prompt: Det du har gjort tidigare i arbetslivet
cards.explanation_md: *Expérience professionnelle* = arbetslivserfarenhet, en rubrik i CV:t.
cards.prompt_en: What you have done in your career so far
cards.explanation_en: *Expérience professionnelle* = work experience, a CV heading.

cards.explanation_md: Språkkunskaper: *les compétences linguistiques*.
cards.explanation_en: Language skills: *les compétences linguistiques*.

cards.swedish_prompt: När arbetsgivaren tar in en ny person
cards.explanation_md: *Il a été embauché en CDI.* Motsats: *licencier* (säga upp).
cards.prompt_en: When the employer takes someone on
cards.explanation_en: *Il a été embauché en CDI.* Opposite: *licencier* (to lay off).

cards.swedish_target: le temps partiel / le temps plein
cards.explanation_md: *Travailler à temps partiel.* Lagstadgad heltid: 35 timmar i veckan.
cards.explanation_en: *Travailler à temps partiel.* The legal full-time week: 35 hours.

cards.explanation_md: *Être au chômage* = vara arbetslös. Ersättning via *France Travail*.
cards.explanation_en: *Être au chômage* = to be unemployed. Benefits via *France Travail*.

cards.explanation_md: Uppsägningen: *la démission*. Den andra parten säger upp dig: *licencier*.
cards.explanation_en: The resignation: *la démission*. Being dismissed: *être licencié*.

cards.explanation_md: Synonym till *à mon avis*. Också: *selon moi*.
cards.explanation_en: Synonym of *à mon avis*. Also: *selon moi*.
